purpose: Prove the Garden of Arrival is a welcome ritual and origins alter early context without constraining long-term potential.
given: A human and one or more companions are forming a new Adventure Pair journey.
when: The party chooses or receives an origin and enters First Grove.
expected: The origin exposes one distinct early traversal cue and discovery route.
The party enters with a known home/return anchor.
Companion first forms remain mutable expressions.
forbidden: Origin permanently locks a profession, body capability, practice ceiling or relationship role.
Choosing a companion first form creates a new lineage or resets relationship continuity.
